transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I keep forgetting scheduled callbacks, work orders, and basic follow-ups I told people I’d handle. It’s all piled up at work, and they sent me here because I could lose my chance to move up.
When did you first start having these difficulties with forgetfulness and staying organized?

Honestly, since grade school. Teachers used to say I was bright, but I was always losing papers, missing parts of the directions, and needing reminders to finish my classwork. This was long before the pressure at this job.
Do you often feel physically restless or find yourself constantly fidgeting and having trouble sitting still?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed being especially fidgety or unable to sit still.
Do you find that you are easily distracted by things going on around you?
Yes. I’ll be reading a digital work order, and halfway through the notes a noise or another job pulls my attention. Then I realize I don’t even know what I just read.
